codebook.Weight-Ordered Rectangle Greedy: Greedily add valid axis-aligned or 45° rectangles, prioritizing new-point weight while rejecting occupied perimeters and reused segments; scanning, random tie-breaking, and lazy candidate queues are implementation variants.
codebook.Shortest-Perimeter Random Restarts: Repeat randomized greedy constructions favoring shortest-perimeter feasible rectangles, retaining the best run.
codebook.Weight-Perturbed Random Restarts: Repeat greedy constructions with weight-perturbed point ordering and random feasible rectangle selection, retaining the best run.
codebook.Mixed-Objective Random Restarts: Repeat randomized greedy constructions, switching candidate selection among random, minimum-perimeter, and maximum-area modes, and retain the best-scoring run.
codebook.Weight-Perimeter Random Restarts: Repeat randomized greedy constructions scoring candidates by new-point weight minus a perimeter penalty, retaining the best run.
codebook.Prefix-Restart Local Search: Iteratively truncate the best solution to a random prefix, rebuild its state, and greedily refill with jitter, retaining improvements.
codebook.Weight-Perimeter Greedy: Build one solution using lazy best-first greedy selection scored by new-point weight minus a perimeter penalty.
codebook.Gain-Cost Local Search: Use iterated local-search restarts with greedy refilling prioritized by gain per cost, incorporating new-point weight, future potential, and blocked-segment penalties.
codebook.Expansion-Densification Local Search: Use iterated local-search restarts with greedy refilling that mixes largest-perimeter frontier expansion with densification.
codebook.Cell-Ordered Perimeter Restarts: Repeat greedy constructions scanning empty cells by descending weight, choosing the shortest-perimeter feasible rectangle for each cell until fixpoint.
codebook.Weight-Quadratic-Size Random Restarts: Repeat greedy constructions ranking deduplicated candidates by new-point weight minus a quadratic size penalty, retaining the best run.
codebook.Mixed-Perimeter Random Restarts: Repeat randomized greedy constructions mixing uniform, minimum-perimeter, and maximum-perimeter candidate selection, retaining the best run.
codebook.Subset-Removal Local Search: Repeatedly remove random subsets of rectangles and invalidated dependents, greedily regrow with randomization, and retain the best solution.
codebook.Two-Phase Objective Random Restarts: Repeat greedy constructions that switch from perimeter-penalized selection to pure new-point weight, varying phase-switch and penalty parameters.
